articles.title: Mesa West Provides $62M Refi for Silicon Valley Office Property
articles.narrative: LBA Realty has secured a $61.5 million refinancing loan for a 125,000-square-foot Class A office property in Sunnyvale, CA. Mesa West provided the debt, which was arranged by JLL Capital Markets. The property, built in 2021, benefits from a tight Class A office market in Silicon Valley, characterized by strong technology sector growth and limited new supply.

data_points.notable_features: Class A office property with on-site solar power generation.
data_points.project_notes: Property was previously acquired by LBA Realty for $42.3 million in June 2025 after falling into receivership due to a default on construction debt by previous owners.

articles.market_intelligence: Class A office space availability in Sunnyvale declined to 11% in Q2 2026, marking the third consecutive quarter of declines. Sunnyvale has not seen new Class A office deliveries in recent years.

articles.title: JLL Promotes Angela Gentry to Market Lead for New York
Takenaka Under Contract to Buy One Broadway for $170M
articles.narrative: Takenaka Corporation is under contract to acquire One Broadway, a 230,000-square-foot office building in New York City, for $170 million from Rockwood Capital and Midtown Equities. The historic 12-story property, which was gut-renovated in 2020 and is fully leased to a strong tenant mix, was previously purchased by the sellers in 2018 for $140 million with plans for repositioning. This acquisition aligns with Takenaka's strategy of collecting unique trophy properties in the U.S.

data_points.notable_features: Historic building listed on the National Register of Historic Places, gut-renovated in 2020.
data_points.project_notes: Sellers Rockwood Capital and Midtown Equities purchased the property for $140 million in 2018.

articles.title: Amazon’s Same-Day Delivery Expansion Reignites Demand for Last-Mile Logistics
articles.narrative: Amazon's proposed expansion of its same-day delivery network, codenamed Project Mercury, is poised to significantly impact the industrial real estate market, particularly for last-mile logistics. The plan aims to establish over 1,000 new facilities within 10 miles of 80% of U.S. Prime members, making a vast array of products almost instantly available. This move by Amazon, along with similar strategies from major retailers like Walmart, Home Depot, and AutoZone, is driving a decisive shift in retail and industrial real estate, increasing demand for urban infill warehousing and small-bay industrial properties. Experts note that final-mile industrial space currently has the tightest vacancy rates, with structural market changes and growing demand continuing to constrain supply. The imperative for faster delivery is blurring the lines between retail and industrial, as stores are increasingly utilized as staging areas for delivery and pickup, leading to new store designs and investments in distribution hubs.

articles.market_intelligence: Final mile industrial real estate has the tightest vacancy rates. The market is experiencing a 'flight to speed' in urban industrial, leading to significant rental rate growth for small-bay warehouses and industrial infill portfolios. Retailers are expanding store footprints to accommodate more delivery and pickup options, blurring the lines between retail and industrial real estate. Premiums on rent are observed for retail and grocery-anchored sites designed for delivery, featuring storage lockers, optimized delivery routing, and extra parking for trucks and pickup lanes.

articles.title: Real Estate Operating System HqO Launches AI Platform for Workflows, Data
articles.narrative: HqO, a real estate operating system provider, has launched REX, an AI platform designed to streamline data and workflows across commercial real estate portfolios. The platform, built on HqO's Digital Grid, aims to provide a unified record for building data, enabling features like AI-powered service request routing, preventive maintenance automation, and proactive tenant health monitoring. REX is now available in 24 countries, with HqO also offering an 'AI builder group' to embed its team within client operations to facilitate adoption and maximize the platform's utility.

articles.title: JLL Arranges $333.3M Refinancing for 1,184-Unit Multifamily Portfolio Near Denver
articles.narrative: JLL Capital Markets has arranged $333.3 million in bridge financing for Palomino Park, a 1,184-unit multifamily portfolio in Highlands Ranch, an unincorporated master-planned community south of Denver. Greystar provided the floating-rate loan to a real estate fund advised by Crow Holdings Capital. The financing will retire existing loans and fund ongoing value-add renovations across the three communities within the portfolio, building on significant capital improvements already made since the borrower acquired the assets in 2021.

data_points.notable_features: The communities are anchored by the Colorado Club, a 26,000-square-foot central amenity facility with a resort-style pool, gym, sports courts, and a full-service bar, surrounded by a 17-acre park.
data_points.project_notes: The financing includes $325 million at initial funding and $8.3 million in future funding for unit renovations. The borrower has invested significant capital in interior and exterior improvements since acquiring the assets in 2021.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Brokers Sale of 1,042-Unit Self-Storage Portfolio in Greater Houston
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of a five-property self-storage portfolio totaling 1,042 units across the greater Houston area. The portfolio comprises 148,745 net rentable square feet of climate- and non-climate-controlled space, along with boat and RV storage, and includes over 12 acres for future expansion. The seller and buyer were not disclosed.

data_points.notable_features: Includes climate- and non-climate-controlled space, as well as boat and RV storage.

articles.title: Akara, DEVEN to Break Ground on 305-Bed Student Housing Project Near San Diego State University
articles.narrative: A joint venture between Akara Partners and Development Ventures (DEVEN) Group is preparing to break ground on a 305-bed student housing development near San Diego State University. The eight-story, transit-oriented project will feature 110 units across 98,500 square feet and is slated for completion before the 2028-2029 academic year. JLL Capital Markets facilitated the partnership for this significant student housing initiative.

data_points.notable_features: Transit-oriented development located near San Diego State University campus.

articles.title: April Housing Underway on $19.3M Renovation of McKinney Affordable Housing Complex
articles.narrative: April Housing, the affordable housing division of Blackstone Real Estate, has commenced a $19.3 million renovation of Skyway Villas, a 232-unit complex in McKinney, Texas. This extensive upgrade is part of a re-syndication effort designed to extend the property's affordability status for an additional 30 years. The project will introduce modern interior finishes, exterior improvements, and significant enhancements to building systems and residential amenities.

data_points.project_notes: Renovation is part of a re-syndication to preserve affordability for 30 years.

articles.title: CBRE Secures $32.8M Refinancing for Hilton Garden Inn Hotel in Cupertino, California
articles.narrative: CBRE has secured a $32.8 million refinancing loan for the Hilton Garden Inn Cupertino, a 164-key hotel in Cupertino, California. The financing was arranged for a partnership between Heil & Associates and Terracommercial, who have owned and operated the property since 2007. The hotel offers a range of amenities including dining options, meeting space, and recreational facilities.

data_points.notable_features: Features Pavilion Cafe, 24-hour Pavilion Pantry market, outdoor pool and spa, fitness center, guest laundry, and 1,650 square feet of meeting space.
data_points.project_notes: Heil & Associates and Terracommercial have owned and operated the hotel since acquiring it in 2007.

articles.title: St. Louis’ Gray Design Group hires project associate
Cooper Commercial Investment Group closes sale of urgent care center in Medina
articles.narrative: Cooper Commercial Investment Group recently brokered the sale of the University Hospitals Urgent Care Center in Medina, Ohio. The $3.1 million transaction provides the buyer, a Midwest-based private investor, with a stable healthcare-focused asset featuring a recently executed lease with approximately eight years remaining.

data_points.notable_features: Healthcare-focused tenancy with a recently executed lease.

articles.title: Chicago’s Prudential Plaza to become permanent home of to Siskel & Ebert statue
articles.narrative: Wanxiang America Real Estate Group, owner of Chicago's Prudential Plaza, announced the planned installation of a life-size bronze sculpture honoring film critics Gene Siskel and Roger Ebert. The six-foot-five interactive statue, titled "Siskel & Ebert: Two Thumbs Up," will be created by acclaimed Illinois sculptor Preston Jackson and is expected to be installed in early 2028. The project is spearheaded by Chicago film producer Pam Kasper and funded through corporate donations, public fundraising, and a Hollywood memorabilia auction.

data_points.phase_1: additional 30,000 square feet of amenities and a new lobby at Randolph St.
data_points.notable_features: Iconic office complex in the East Loop, connecting to Metra's Millennium Station and the Pedway, across from Millennium Park.
data_points.project_notes: The statue project is being funded by corporate donations, public fundraising via Chicago Gateway Green, and a Hollywood memorabilia auction. Prudential Plaza underwent a loan modification in early 2024, launching a multimillion-dollar capital campaign for property enhancements, with Phase One nearing completion and Phase Two launching in 2027.

articles.title: Lee & Associates closes 43,235-square-foot industrial lease in Dallas
articles.narrative: Lee & Associates Dallas-Fort Worth recently facilitated a new lease agreement for a 43,235-square-foot industrial property in Dallas. The transaction involved EastGroup Properties as the landlord and ULC Connects as the tenant, securing space at Interstate Warehouse V.

articles.title: Cawley Commercial Real Estate brokers sale of 29,600-square-foot industrial property in Carol Stream
articles.narrative: Cawley Commercial Real Estate recently brokered the direct sale of a 29,600-square-foot industrial property in Carol Stream, Illinois. High Street Logistics Properties acquired the Class B facility, which features a mix of warehouse, office, and specialized service space. The property's strategic location near Interstate 355 and its robust infrastructure, including multiple loading docks and drive-in doors, make it a valuable asset for industrial users in the western suburban market.

data_points.address: 170 S. Gary Avenue, Carol Stream, IL
data_points.notable_features: Class B industrial property with 24-foot clear ceiling heights, six interior loading docks with lifts, five interior drive-in doors, a mechanic repair bay, and a steel mezzanine. A full office renovation was completed in 2023.

articles.title: Tratt Starts Work on 1.35M-SF Winter Haven Spec Warehouse
articles.narrative: Tratt Properties is commencing construction on a 1.35 million-square-foot speculative warehouse in Winter Haven, Florida. This $40 million project is part of the larger 8.1 million-square-foot Central Florida Integrated Logistics Park. The site for the warehouse was acquired in 2021 for $4.14 million, and the park offers crucial rail access.

data_points.notable_features: Part of an 8.1 million-square-foot logistics park with rail access.
data_points.project_notes: Site previously acquired in 2021 for $4.14 million.

articles.title: Embrey, Southstar Close on $71M Construction Loan for Nashville-Area Apartment Project
articles.narrative: A joint venture between Embrey Partners and Southstar Development secured a $71 million senior construction loan from PCCP for the development of Crossings Boulevard, a 360-unit apartment community in Spring Hill, TN. The Class A, garden-style project is part of a larger 213-acre master-planned community and is expected to be completed in Q1 2028. The development will offer a strong amenity package, including a fitness studio, pool, and pet-friendly features, catering to the growing demand in the Nashville-area market.

data_points.address: 4101 Legacy Point Trail, Spring Hill, TN
data_points.notable_features: Class A, three-story, garden-style community located within a 213-acre master-planned community; amenities include a conference room, micro-offices, fitness studio, yoga room, pool with cabanas, outdoor kitchen, dog park, pet spa, coffee bar, EV charging stations, and secure package room.

articles.title: Investor Duo Acquires Two Tennessee LIHTC Apartment Assets
articles.narrative: Western Wealth Capital (WWC) and FSO Capital Partners have acquired a two-property, 192-unit affordable housing portfolio in Tennessee for $20.7 million. The portfolio includes River City North Apartment Homes in Chattanooga and Meadow Creek Apartment Homes in Goodlettsville, north of Nashville. This acquisition leverages FSO Capital Partners' expertise in Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) investments, ensuring the properties continue to provide below-market rents under existing Section 42 LIHTC Land Use Restriction Agreements.

data_points.property_name: River City North Apartment Homes / Meadow Creek Apartment Homes
data_points.notable_features: Both communities operate under Section 42 LIHTC Land Use Restriction Agreements (LURAs), holding rents below market levels.
data_points.project_notes: River City North was built in 2007 and Meadow Creek in 2003. River City North is financed with an $8.47 million loan at a 6.17% fixed rate with five years of interest-only payments. Meadow Creek's existing $7.79 million mortgage was assumed at a 4.60% blended rate.

articles.title: Brookfield Reinforces Qatar Presence with New Doha Office
articles.narrative: Brookfield has established a new office in Doha, Qatar, to strengthen its presence and investment activities in the region. This expansion is anchored by its global credit platform, which includes the recently acquired Oaktree. The move builds on Brookfield's existing partnerships and significant investments in Qatar, notably a planned $20 billion joint venture with Qai, the artificial intelligence subsidiary of the Qatar Investment Authority, focused on developing AI infrastructure both locally and internationally. The firm aims to collaborate closely with local partners to identify new investment opportunities.

articles.title: Blanca CRE Hires Former Nuveen Exec: The South Florida Deal Sheet
REITs' Share Of Senior Housing Deals Has Doubled. Will Development Follow?
articles.narrative: Public REITs have significantly increased their share of senior housing transactions, doubling their activity compared to previous periods. This surge is attributed to REITs' ability to execute deals quickly and at a lower cost than private buyers, giving them a competitive edge in the market. The article raises the question of whether this increased acquisition activity will translate into a corresponding rise in new senior housing development by these REITs.

articles.title: South Jersey Affordable Housing Developers Blame State 'Overregulation' For Constricted Supply
articles.narrative: Affordable housing developers in South Jersey are attributing the region's shortage of attainable housing units to what they describe as excessive statewide regulations. They argue that current state policies are hindering the creation of much-needed affordable housing supply.

articles.title: Charlotte Extends Data Center Moratorium For 11 More Months
articles.narrative: Charlotte has extended its moratorium on new data center projects for an additional 11 months to allow for further policy development. This decision indicates the city's intent to carefully consider the implications of data center growth and establish comprehensive guidelines for future developments.

articles.title: The 'Zombie' Building Mirage: How Owners Who Can't Transact Are Stirring The Market
articles.narrative: A new report by CBRE highlights a significant issue in the Washington D.C. office market, identifying 30 large blocks of office space, totaling 5.5 million square feet, where owners are currently unable to secure new leases. This phenomenon, dubbed 'zombie space,' indicates a substantial portion of the market that is effectively frozen, impacting overall transaction activity and market dynamics.
articles.market_intelligence: CBRE's analysis reveals 5.5 million square feet of 'zombie space' in Washington D.C. office market, representing 30 large blocks where owners cannot transact new deals.
